metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature over the Mesquite Flat higher than over the Panamint Mountains on June 30, 2013, as observed with Landsat 8?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Collection: Landsat 8 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2) - Date: June 30, 2013 - Locations: Mesquite Flat and Panamint Mountains (Death Valley area, California) - Band: ST_B10 (thermal band for land surface temperature in Kelvin) 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Landsat 8 was launched Feb 2013, so June 30, 2013 is within its operational period - Use QA_PIXEL band to mask clouds and bad pixels - No need to mask clouds for this comparison since we're comparing two regions on the same date 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Check if collection has images for that date - After masking, verify pixel counts > 0 for both regions - LST should be in valid Kelvin range (~250-330K for surface temps) - Compare mean LST values between regions - A: Mesquite Flat LST > Panamint Mountains LST - B: Mesquite Flat LST ≤ Panamint Mountains LST - C1: No images found for that date - C2: Valid pixels = 0 after masking - C3: Invalid LST values (NaN, out of range) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometries for Mesquite Flat and Panamint Mountains const mesquitFlat = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-117.0, 36.3, -116.7, 36.5]); const panamintMountains = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-117.2, 36.2, -116.85, 36.5]); // Filter Landsat 8 for June 30, 2013 const startDate = '2013-06-30'; const endDate = '2013-07-01'; let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(mesquitFlat.union(panamintMountains)); const imgCount = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found for June 30, 2013: ${imgCount}`); if (imgCount === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 8 images found for this date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get first image (should be only one for this date) const image = collection.first(); // Apply QA pixel mask to remove clouds and bad pixels const qaPixel = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qaPixel.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // Cloud shadow .and(qaPixel.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // Cloud .and(qaPixel.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // Cloud confidence const maskedImage = image.select('ST_B10').updateMask(cloudMask); // Calculate LST stats for Mesquite Flat const mesquitStats = maskedImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: mesquitFlat, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mesquitLST = mesquitStats.ST_B10_mean; const mesquitPixels = mesquitStats.ST_B10_count; console.log(`Mesquite Flat - LST: ${mesquitLST?.toFixed(2) || 'null'} K, Pixels: ${mesquitPixels || 0}`); // Calculate LST stats for Panamint Mountains const panamintStats = maskedImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: panamintMountains, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const panamintLST = panamintStats.ST_B10_mean; const panamintPixels = panamintStats.ST_B10_count; console.log(`Panamint Mountains - LST: ${panamintLST?.toFixed(2) || 'null'} K, Pixels: ${panamintPixels || 0}`); // Validate results if (mesquitPixels === 0 || panamintPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mesquitLST === null || mesquitLST === undefined || panamintLST === null || panamintLST === undefined) { console.log('Invalid LST values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (mesquitLST > panamintLST) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
